user_review.method: Maintainer first-use replay using genuine local CLI processes and fictional instructions in a new isolated project. No independent fresh agent session or maintenance-cost study.

scenarios.request: After three launch-day changes, what is current and why?
scenarios.expected: Retrieve Thursday with the latest original wording while leaving the first three revisions audit-only.
scenarios.observed: The demo created four revisions, retrieved only Thursday in a new local brief process, and read all four exact source excerpts with only revision 4 eligible for execution.

scenarios.request: A delayed writer still thinks revision 2 is current.
scenarios.expected: Reject the stale update and leave revision 4 authoritative.
scenarios.observed: The live capture CLI returned exit 2 with expected_revision must be 4. A later brief still returned Thursday only.

scenarios.request: Point the sample at an existing folder.
scenarios.observed: The demo exited 1 at exclusive directory creation.

similar_skills.learned: A visible short example reduces uncertainty about the result.
similar_skills.reason: Expose a one-command replay and the exact distinction between a CLI check and a fresh-host handoff.

similar_skills.learned: Index lookup precedes full observation retrieval.
similar_skills.reason: Demonstrate the existing brief and exact revision reader instead of inventing a new retrieval engine.

similar_skills.learned: Background extraction is distinct from an actual storage receipt.
similar_skills.reason: Keep explicit CLI captures and observed receipts; do not infer capture or fresh-host retrieval from a conversational acknowledgment.

validation.observed: Four revisions, one current decision with exact evidence, three readable historical revisions, and one stale writer rejected.
